results.name: Sphere Contacts
results.method: Both renderers draw each completed physics step on the same GPUDevice. Order alternates. Identical shaders, geometry, camera, resolution, no antialiasing and no debug overlays. GPU draw timestamps exclude copies; GPU copy time and CPU submission are separate. Completion is CPU submission through GPU queue completion, not display FPS. Selected complete body records match before and after drawing. No render pose downloads or per-frame CPU instance matrix updates.
